title: Sampling Methods
motto: Sampling is how AI explores the space of possibilities.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Sampling is how AI explores the space of possibilities.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A language model finishes processing your prompt and produces a vector of 50,000 logits. One for every token in its vocabulary. Now it has to pick one. How?

If it always picks the highest-probability token, every response is identical. Deterministic. Boring. If it picks uniformly at random, the output is gibberish. The answer lives somewhere between these extremes, and that somewhere is controlled by sampling.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Mini-batches are random samples from the dataset. Shuffling each epoch prevents order bias.
